purpose: Company-notice classification of three exact CNINFO other events; original provider codes retained.

notices.source_title: 潍柴动力2022-029：关于回购公司A股股份的方案
notices.finding: Board approved buying existing A shares on May 19 for later incentives; this event is a repurchase plan, not issuance.

notices.source_title: 中国石化2022-52：关于注销已回购股份暨股份变动的公告
notices.finding: The later notice explicitly confirms the November 25 A-share repurchase completion; use this later disclosure date for the classification.

notices.source_title: 中国外运临2023-001：关于回购公司A股股份实施结果暨股份变动的公告
notices.finding: Issuer notice mirrored as an HKEX overseas regulatory filing: 49,280,000 existing A shares repurchased by December 30, held in the repurchase account.
